channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Hospital in Yemen’s Taiz warns of collapse in days because of Houthi siege
item.description: Dialysis patients face shorter treatment sessions as severe shortages of fuel, medicines, and oxygen threaten hospitals.

item.title: Argentina identifies dozens of victims killed in its ‘Dirty War’
item.description: Forensic anthropologists have identified the remains of at least 38 victims of Argentina’s last military dictatorship.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran says US military banned entirely from Gulf entry
item.description: Iran top general says US military vessels will not be allowed to enter the Gulf "under any circumstances."

item.title: Masked gunmen kill seven in attack on church funeral in Jordan
item.description: At least seven people were killed and 34 wounded after two masked gunmen opened fire at a church in Karak, Jordan.

item.title: Time ‘running out’ to reach Yemen’s Taiz amid deepening crisis, UN says
item.description: More than 800,000 people have been cut off from aid since the Houthis encircled Taiz city in early October.

item.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
item.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

item.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
item.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.
